title: Clean Oracle-Free v2 4-Step DDGAN Bimodal Chain
intuition: Clean oracle-free v2 DDGAN bimodal chain testing whether public conditional DDGAN reverse transitions preserve both bimodal branches and final ancestral distribution with calibrated terminal_observations=1 and zero host-owned target-variance div_loss.
failure_mode: Without host-side variance regularization, conditional reverse steps average across the two modes or lose conditioned branch fidelity.
protocol_notes: Clean oracle-free v2 benchmark (5,000 updates, 600s timeout); preserves legacy model_ddgan_bimodal_chain untouched.
